overview: The National Centre for Textile Design (NCTD) is an autonomous body under the Office of the Development Commissioner for Handlooms, Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. It functions as a premier institute for design development, training, and research in the textile and handicrafts sector. NCTD aims to enhance the competitiveness of Indian textiles through innovative design interventions, skill upgradation, and market linkage support. It serves designers, weavers, artisans, exporters, and textile industries by providing design services, forecasting trends, and promoting traditional and contemporary textile arts.
objectives: To provide design development and forecasting services to the textile and handicrafts sector
To upgrade skills of designers, weavers, and artisans through training programmes
To promote traditional Indian textiles and contemporary design innovation
To strengthen market linkages for handloom and handicraft products
To conduct research and documentation on textile heritage and emerging trends
To support export promotion through design intervention and product development
eligibility: Eligibility varies by programme; generally open to individual designers, weavers, artisans, self-help groups, cooperatives, NGOs, exporters, and textile/handicraft units seeking design support, training, or market linkage services from NCTD.
benefits: Access to professional design services, trend forecasting, prototype development, training in design software and traditional techniques, product development support, market linkage assistance, participation in design exhibitions and buyer-seller meets, and documentation of traditional designs.
financial_support: NCTD provides design and technical support services; financial support such as grants or subsidies is not directly provided by NCTD but may be facilitated through linkage with Ministry of Textiles schemes like NHDP, HSS, or CDP. Specific financial quantum or mechanism is not detailed in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Visit the NCTD website at https://nctd.gov.in 2. Explore available programmes such as design development, training, or trend services 3. Contact NCTD via email or phone to express interest 4. Submit required documents based on the specific programme 5. Await evaluation and approval from NCTD officials 6. Upon acceptance, avail the selected service or enrol in the training programme.
required_documents: Details of existing products or craft practiced
Bank details (if applicable for any financial linkage)
Specific design brief or requirement (for design service requests)
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year depending on programme availability.
implementing_agency: Office of the Development Commissioner for Handlooms, Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
caveats: Services are subject to availability of experts and programme schedules
Financial assistance, if any, is routed through allied Ministry of Textiles schemes and not directly disbursed by NCTD
Design intellectual property rights may be governed by specific agreements
Priority may be given to clusters, cooperatives, and export-oriented units
